description: This file defines the StudioParser class, which provides functionality for parsing, editing, and managing layout files and templates in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM Studio module. It includes methods for parsing HTML forms, handling file operations, generating UI components, and integrating with other Studio components.

classes.name: StudioParser
classes.description: A class providing parsing, editing, and management functionality for layout files and templates within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM Studio module.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the normalized file type based on input, optionally setting the current type.

methods.name: getParsers
methods.description: Determines and returns appropriate parsers for a given filename based on naming conventions.

methods.name: parseRows
methods.description: Extracts table row elements from HTML content.

methods.name: parseNames
methods.description: Finds all name attributes in HTML content.

methods.name: parseLabels
methods.description: Extracts localization label placeholders from HTML content.

methods.name: getMaxPosition
methods.description: Calculates the maximum position number among parsed element positions.

methods.name: parsePositions
methods.description: Parses position span elements within HTML content to determine layout positions.

methods.name: parseCols
methods.description: Extracts table cell elements from HTML content.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Performs general parsing on HTML content, focusing on positions.

methods.name: positionCount
methods.description: Counts position span elements within HTML content.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Counts table row elements within HTML content.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a specified file's content into the parser object.

methods.name: buildImageButtons
methods.description: Constructs HTML for a set of image-based buttons, optionally arranged horizontally or vertically.

methods.name: generateButtons
methods.description: Creates a set of standard UI buttons for the Studio form.

methods.name: getFormButtons
methods.description: Returns HTML for the form's action buttons.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the HTML form markup including buttons.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves file definitions for a module, optionally by specific file ID.

methods.name: getWorkingFile
methods.description: Returns the path to a working copy of a file, copying from source if necessary.

methods.name: getSwapWith
methods.description: Calculates the index of the slot to swap with, based on a given value.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Parses submitted data to update layout file slots and save modifications.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves layout content to a file, with special handling for search forms.

methods.name: handleSaveLabels
methods.description: Saves label changes via the LabelEditor component.

methods.name: disableInputs
methods.description: Adds disabled and readonly attributes to input and select elements in HTML content.

methods.name: enableLabelEditor
methods.description: Enables inline editing of localization labels within HTML content.

methods.name: writeToCache
methods.description: Writes a view to cache and manages label and input disabling.

methods.name: populateRequestFromBuffer
methods.description: Parses a buffer file to populate the $_REQUEST superglobal with form data.

methods.name: cacheXTPL
methods.description: Creates cached template files, integrating with XTemplate system and form handling.

methods.name: yahooJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for Yahoo UI drag & drop support.

methods.name: addSlotToForm
methods.description: Adds hidden input fields to form to track layout slots.

methods.name: prepSlots
methods.description: Prepares layout slots with corresponding HTML and form inputs for drag-and-drop editing.

methods.name: parseOldestFile
methods.description: Loads and parses the oldest backup of a layout file for comparison or restoring.

methods.name: clearWorkingDirectory
methods.description: Removes the working directory used for temporary file editing.

methods.name: upgradeToSmarty
methods.description: Converts template syntax from standard PHP to Smarty syntax.
